messages.text: Where is my order? Order #····-A, email (email hidden)

Got it, your order is paid and hasn't shipped yet. The Magic Miner 40T ships October 31, 2026, and the Harlo OS Diagnostics + 3-Month RMA goes out with it to (address hidden). Tracking will come to (email hidden) once it leaves the warehouse, so worth whitelisting us so it doesn't land in spam. Anything else you want me to check on it?
Any issues with the shipping to Australia, id rather try to avoid the 10% gst tax here

Shipping to Australia is fine, we send there regularly and Abel's confirmed Magic Miner units are going out to AU. On the GST, that one's not something I can work around. It's charged under Australian import rules on the value of the goods, not something we set or can mark down on the paperwork. Your order total of $839 is what you've paid us. If you want, I can check whether GST was already collected at checkout or gets charged on arrival.

Fair, and I'm not going to guess at the threshold or how it's applied to your order. What I can see is the $839 total; I can't see a GST line broken out from here. Let me get the team to confirm exactly what was charged at checkout and what, if anything, comes due on arrival. They'll come back to you on it.
Handed to the team · Tax/charge breakdown not visible in the order lookup; needs a person to confirm.

Abel or Georges has been pinged and one of them will jump in here with the exact tax breakdown. Stay in the chat if you can; if you step away, the answer comes to your email. Nothing changes on the order in the meantime, the Magic Miner 40T is still set to ship October 31.
All good, thank you. Once the first one lands & is up an running I'll look to add another two. Is there any preferred pricing available for repeat buyers please?

Glad to hear it. I can't set pricing or mint codes myself, so I won't promise you a number. What I can do is put the multi-unit question in front of the team while they're already on your chat, so they can tell you what they can do on two more 40Ts when you're ready to order. Worth flagging then too, since pricing moves by batch.
Handed to the team · Repeat-buyer / multi-unit pricing is not mine to quote.

That's with them now, same thread as the GST question, so you'll get both answers together here or by email. And good call running one first before you scale up, the 40T at $799 is the best value per TH we sell, so two more is a sensible next step.
Nice one, appreciate it. Is this AI or am I communicating with a human?

I'm the team's automated first line, so not a person, but Abel or Georges step in directly when something needs a human, which is exactly what's happening on your GST and pricing questions. They'll reply in this same chat.
